append.detail: UPDATE 2026-11-10 (P5 slice 1, pure, best-practice call under the owner's standing authorization): lib/commerce/cart.ts is the cart MODEL: lines of (product, variant, qty), add/set/remove, guest-into-member merge, prune against live stock with a report, and a tolerant parser for stored carts. It holds no price and no seller on purpose: a saved price goes stale, so both are read fresh from the product rows at checkout, where funds-flow.ts already splits one or many sellers. Nothing calls it yet. Decision recorded: the persistent store is a per-buyer row holding the parsed lines (a migration plus a policy PR, Daniel applies SQL after merge), written in its own slice.
